neon-synthwave.name: 霓虹合成波
neon-synthwave.promptZh: 霓虹合成波风格，赛博朋克，深紫黑底＋品红青光晕，扫描线，80 年代复古未来，高对比霓虹描边
neon-synthwave.promptEn: neon synthwave style, cyberpunk, deep purple-black background with magenta and cyan glow, retro-futuristic 80s, high-contrast neon rim light

negative.zh: 写实照片，杂乱背景，低对比，土黄
negative.en: photorealistic, cluttered background, low contrast, muddy brown

pixel-retro.name: 像素复古
pixel-retro.promptZh: 16 位像素风，复古掌机调色板，硬边像素，清晰轮廓，透明底，游戏精灵图标
pixel-retro.promptEn: 16-bit pixel art, retro handheld palette, hard-edged pixels, crisp silhouette, transparent background, game sprite icon

negative.zh: 模糊，抗锯齿，渐变噪点，写实

cartoon-thick.name: 厚描边卡通
cartoon-thick.promptZh: 厚描边卡通风格，明快饱和色，扁平上色，粗黑轮廓线，友好可爱，干净白底
cartoon-thick.promptEn: thick-outline cartoon style, bright saturated colors, flat shading, bold black outlines, friendly and cute, clean white background

negative.zh: 写实，暗沉，噪点，细碎纹理
negative.en: photorealistic, dark, noisy, fine cluttered texture

disney-supercell.name: 迪斯尼×Supercell
disney-supercell.promptZh: 迪士尼动画质感与 Supercell 手游风融合：厚涂立体卡通，糖果般饱和明快配色，圆润造型，柔和顶光与温暖环境色，干净厚白描边，高品质手游图标级打磨
disney-supercell.promptEn: Disney animation charm fused with Supercell mobile game polish: chunky 3d-ish cartoon, candy-bright saturated colors, rounded friendly shapes, soft top light with warm bounce, clean thick white outline, premium mobile game icon quality

negative.zh: 写实照片，恐怖，暗沉，噪点，锯齿，粗糙涂鸦
negative.en: photorealistic, horror, dark and muddy, noisy, jagged edges, rough doodle

dreamy-pastel.name: 梦幻少女（暖暖系）
dreamy-pastel.promptZh: 日系少女向换装游戏插画：水彩柔光，粉彩糖果色，蕾丝与缎带细节，梦幻光斑，精致时装质感，干净轮廓，高品质手游立绘
dreamy-pastel.promptEn: japanese shoujo dress-up game illustration: watercolor soft light, pastel candy palette, lace and ribbon details, dreamy bokeh sparkle, refined fashion fabric rendering, clean silhouette, premium mobile game art

negative.zh: 写实照片，硬阴影，暗黑恐怖，粗糙线条，男性化
negative.en: photorealistic, harsh shadows, dark horror, rough sketchy lines, masculine
